cards.mood: The piece opens with a mysterious and submerged atmosphere, characterized by low-frequency tension and restraint.
cards.palette: A full string ensemble serves as the harmonic backbone, starting with sustained, low-register pads that create tension, then expanding into sweeping, high-register melodic lines during the climax.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a somber, mysterious atmosphere that establishes a sense of isolation and depth.
cards.palette: A lush string section serves as the harmonic backbone, starting with sustained, low-register pads and evolving into sweeping, high-register melodic lines that drive the emotional arc.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a fragile, melancholic stillness that gradually accumulates tension through swelling strings and rising melodic lines.
cards.palette: A solo piano provides the initial harmonic foundation with sparse, arpeggiated figures, present from the Intro through the first verse.
